newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Want Want, General Mills in China JV.
newsitem.headline: Want Want, General Mills in China JV.

text.p: Want Want Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had formed a joint venture with General Mills Inc to develop a savoury snacks business in China.
Want Want said in a statement the joint venture would be an equal partnership and would take advantage of the rapidly expanding snack products market in the country.
"We believe this partnership with General Mills will help us toward our goal of developing Want Want into a broadly diversified food company," Want Want chairman Tsai Eng Meng said in the statement.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed.
Want Want, a leading snacks and beverage company in China, is listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore and recorded sales of Singapore $200 million in 1996.
